m.aarti.tek: Victory, victory to Śrī Badarīnātha; victory to the Lord absorbed in yoga and meditation.
m.aarti.pad1: Your form is both without attributes and with them; you are the colour of a rain-cloud, beyond all compare. Indra, king of the gods, the wise and the realised serve your feet.
m.aarti.pad2: A parasol gleams over your head; your beauty is matchless and most wondrous. In telling your holy deeds even the finest speech falls back abashed.
m.aarti.pad3: A broad tilaka marks your forehead, a garland of gems and pearls is at your neck. Protector of those who bow to you, most merciful, you give happiness to your servants.
m.aarti.pad4: Lovely earrings hang at your ears; your image is the home of all beauty. By remembering you every wish is fulfilled: so it is said by those who tell your virtues.
m.aarti.pad5: Śiva and Śeṣa sing your virtues, and Indra, the moon and the sun; Śyāmā prays to you always, with both hands joined.
